plan_review.notes: Reviewer rejected the initial loose plan. Adopted explicit Floor 2 per-family encounter state, player-attributed durable kill counters, relock goal semantics, shared Floor1/Floor2 boss-bar resolution, centralized archetype AI mapping, and RunStats family-kill artifact contract. Alt A minimal floor2Scenario imperative patch rejected due door/source coupling. Alt B reuse Floor1 floorScenario bossBattles rejected because Floor2 deliberately owns state in floorExtendedState. Alt C explicit Floor2 encounter state selected.

rounds.notes: Three valid findings: Floor 2 bosses ran AI before den entry, chase bosses received projectile attack range, and resolved spawner arenas left logicalOpen false after clearing their lock config. Fixed by deriving an inactive Floor 2 boss set in enemyAISystem, arming permanent aggro only on encounter activation, assigning attack range only to AI_TYPE.RANGED bosses, and opening arena doors when they resolve. Added regression coverage for inactive bosses, ranged-only boss projectiles, full den door lifecycle, and arena door release.

Both final-round reviewers independently confirmed the first-round fixes and the complete Floor 2 progression diff are clean. Claude explicitly re-verified boss activation, ranged dispatch, arena and den door semantics, player-only kill attribution, HUD resolution, and headless telemetry; Gemini reported no significant issues.

Adjudicator accepted all three independent findings as runtime correctness defects. The fixes preserve explicit Floor 2 encounter ownership: inactive encounter bosses are skipped by AI, activation sets aggro and the relock goal, only ranged archetypes receive attack range, and arena resolution sets both isLocked=0 and logicalOpen=1.
Both independent reviewers converged on no significant issues after the fixes. Adjudicator accepts the clean result at the two-round cap.

supplemental_reviews.reason: Post-PR review fixes for boss targeting, Floor 2 boss loot, render-drain-safe kill ownership, and incremental combat-event consumption.
